basic_info.description: This light-filled 4BD/2.5BA Edwardian condo lives like a single-family home, blending timeless charm with everyday comfort. Coved ceilings, hardwood floors, and classic moldings create a sense of history, while modern updates bring ease and elegance. Step through the welcoming foyer into a sunlit living and dining room with bay windows, a decorative fireplace, and graceful period detail. The open kitchen invites connection...gather around the breakfast bar, cook with top-tier appliances, and enjoy abundant storage and workspace. Down a quiet hall, four restful bedrooms offer space to breathe. The serene primary suite features a box beam ceiling, built-ins, a second fireplace, walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bath with soaking tub and separate shower. A second full bath in the hallway and a powder room make life seamless. A full laundry room with generous storage, one-car deeded parking, and extra garage space, you have everything you need. All just blocks from Union Street, Alta Plaza Park, and the Presidio. This is classic San Francisco living at its best.
